translations.literal: He was promoted commissioner of the Huaidong Commission for Government Integrity; because of a case at a salt works, the commoners Yin Zhizhong and his brothers had falsely confessed to being bandits, and he reversed the verdict.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted commissioner of the Huaidong Commission for Government Integrity, he reversed a salt-works case in which the brothers Yin Zhizhong had been forced to confess to banditry.

sentences.zh: 召還，拜集賢大學士、中奉大夫，商議中書省事。

translations.literal: He was recalled, appointed grand academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies and Grand Master of Palace Attendance, and deliberated on Central Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled to court, he was made grand academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies and Grand Master of Palace Attendance with a seat in Central Secretariat deliberations.

sentences.zh: 丞相完澤卒，孔孫與陳天祥上封事，薦和禮霍孫可為相。

translations.literal: When Chancellor Wanze died, Kongsun and Chen Tianxiang submitted a sealed memorial recommending Helihuosun as fit for chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: When Chancellor Wanze died, Kongsun and Chen Tianxiang submitted a sealed memorial recommending Helihuosun for the chancellorship.

sentences.zh: 會地震，詔問弭災之道，孔孫條對八事，其略曰：蠻夷諸國，不可窮兵遠討；

translations.literal: When there was an earthquake, an edict asked the way to quell calamity; Kongsun itemized eight matters in reply; in summary: the various barbarian states should not be pursued with exhausted armies on distant campaigns;
translations.idiomatic: After an earthquake the emperor asked how to avert calamity; Kongsun replied with eight points, in brief: do not exhaust the armies on distant campaigns against barbarian states;

sentences.zh: 濫官放譴，不可復加任用；

translations.literal: officials dismissed for abuse should not again be employed;
translations.idiomatic: officials dismissed for misconduct should not be reappointed;

sentences.zh: 賞善罰惡，不可數賜赦宥；

translations.literal: in rewarding good and punishing evil, amnesties should not be repeatedly granted;
translations.idiomatic: in rewarding good and punishing evil, do not issue amnesties too often;

sentences.zh: 獻鬻寶貨，不可不為禁絕；

translations.literal: the presentation and sale of precious goods must be strictly forbidden;
translations.idiomatic: the offering and sale of precious goods must be strictly forbidden;

sentences.zh: 供佛無益，不可虛費財用；

translations.literal: supporting Buddhism is of no benefit and state funds should not be wasted on it;
translations.idiomatic: Buddhist offerings bring no benefit and public funds should not be wasted on them;

sentences.zh: 上下豪侈，不可不從儉約；

translations.literal: luxury above and below must be curbed through frugality;
translations.idiomatic: extravagance at court and in the provinces must give way to frugality;

sentences.zh: 官冗吏繁，不可不為裁減；

translations.literal: redundant offices and numerous clerks must be reduced;
translations.idiomatic: redundant offices and excessive clerical staffs must be cut;

sentences.zh: 太廟神主，不可不備祭享。

translations.literal: the spirit tablets of the Imperial Ancestral Temple must not lack sacrificial offerings.
translations.idiomatic: sacrificial rites at the Imperial Ancestral Temple must not be neglected.

sentences.zh: 帝悉嘉納之，賜鈔五千貫。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised and accepted all of them and bestowed five thousand strings of paper currency.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised and accepted all his points and granted him five thousand strings of paper currency.

sentences.zh: 又累疏言：「凡七十致仕者，宜加一官；

translations.literal: He also repeatedly memorialized: "All who retire at seventy should receive one additional rank;
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized repeatedly: "Officials who retire at seventy should receive one additional rank;

sentences.zh: 丁憂服闋者，宜待起復；

translations.literal: those who have completed mourning should await recall;
translations.idiomatic: those who have completed mourning should await recall before reappointment;

sentences.zh: 宿衛之冒濫者，必當革；

translations.literal: those who have improperly entered palace guard service must be reformed;
translations.idiomatic: abuses in the palace guard must be eliminated;

sentences.zh: 州郡之職，必當遴選，久任達魯花赤，宜量加遷轉；

translations.literal: prefectural and commandery posts must be carefully selected; darughachi who serve long in one place should be transferred in due measure;
translations.idiomatic: prefectural posts must be carefully filled; darughachi who serve too long in one place should be rotated;

sentences.zh: 又宜增給官吏俸祿；

translations.literal: official salaries should also be increased;
translations.idiomatic: official salaries should be increased;

sentences.zh: 修建京師廟學，設國子生徒，給賜曲阜孔廟灑掃戶；

translations.literal: temple schools in the capital should be built, Imperial Academy disciples established, and sweeping households for the Qufu Temple of Confucius granted;
translations.idiomatic: temple schools should be built in the capital, Imperial Academy students enrolled, and sweeping households granted for the Confucian temple at Qufu;

sentences.zh: 相位宜參用儒臣，不可專任文吏；

translations.literal: the chancellorship should employ Confucian ministers jointly and not rely solely on clerical officials;
translations.idiomatic: the chancellorship should include Confucian ministers and not be left to clerical officials alone;

sentences.zh: 故相安童、伯顏、和禮霍孫與廉希憲等，各宜贈諡。」

translations.literal: the former chancellors An'tong, Bayan, Helihuosun, and Lian Xixian and others should each be granted posthumous titles."
translations.idiomatic: the late chancellors An'tong, Bayan, Helihuosun, and Lian Xixian should each receive posthumous titles."

sentences.zh: 久之，請老還家，拜翰林學士承旨、資善大夫，致仕，集賢大學士如故。

translations.literal: After a long time he requested to retire on account of age and return home; he was appointed Hanlin Academician Expositor and Grand Master for Goodness, retired from office, and remained grand academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies as before.
translations.idiomatic: After many years he asked to retire; he was made expositor of the Hanlin Academy and Grand Master for Goodness, retired from active service, and retained his grand academician title at the Hall of Gathered Worthies.

sentences.zh: 大德十一年卒，年七十有五。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Dade he died, aged seventy-five.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Dade (1307) he died at the age of seventy-five.

sentences.zh: 孔孫素以文學名，且善琴，工畫山水竹石，而騎射尤精。

translations.literal: Kongsun had long been famed for letters and learning; he was also skilled at the zither, adept at painting landscapes, bamboo, and rocks, and especially accomplished in horsemanship and archery.
translations.idiomatic: Kongsun had long been known for his literary gifts; he was also skilled at the zither, painted landscapes and bamboo, and was especially accomplished in horsemanship and archery.

sentences.zh: 及其立朝，讜言嘉論，有可觀者，士論服之。

translations.literal: When he took his place at court, his forthright words and excellent arguments had much worth seeing, and scholarly opinion submitted to him.
translations.idiomatic: In office his forthright counsel was widely admired, and men of learning held him in esteem.
